name: .429 Cal-205gr (44 mag) Jack Hammer®
note: Recommended use: Personal Defense / Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "Designed for the 44 magnum, this 100% weight retention pure copper Jack Hammer™ pistol bullet is stellar. The cupped nose design has enough expansion to open to caliber diameter and create a large permanent wound channel with deep, straight line penetration. This is an outstanding choice for personal protection or big game hunting." The weight is taken from the product name (205gr).
